Name: Kenneth's Motivational Mails
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Need a little push to start the day?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Motivational Mails is your daily reminder to keep going. One short, powerful mail every morning for a full year - 112 days straight.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]While Inspirational is soft and cozy, this one is built for the grind. For farmers who want to hustle, build, and make things happen.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What makes it different from Inspirational?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Inspirational = calm, reflective, for slow mornings.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Motivational = energy, drive, for grinding and goal-setting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 112 Unique Mails - No repeats, from Spring to Winter.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Hustle mindset - Quotes about starting, pushing, and finishing.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Straight to the point - Short, powerful, no fluff.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lore-friendly - Still feels like Stardew, just with more drive.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lightweight - Content Patcher only, zero lag, works with everything.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Example: "You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great. - Zig Ziglar"[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfect if you like waking up and immediately planning your farm, your mines, your empire.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made by Kf - for farmers who don't wait for opportunity, they create it.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install: SMAPI + Content Patcher. Drop in Mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]If you like cozy mornings instead of grind, check out my other mod: Kenneth's Inspirational Mails.[/b][/size]
